notizie.titolo: Basel Committee publishes more details on the 2026 assessment of global systemically important banks
notizie.descrizione: Basel Committee provides additional information regarding the 2026 G-SIB assessment. Further details include global denominators and individual bank indicators. The release accompanies the Financial Stability Board's updated G-SIB list.

notizie.titolo: Basel Committee discusses risks and vulnerabilities faced by global banking system
notizie.descrizione: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision met in Basel on 18 November 2026 to discuss a range of analytical, supervisory and regulatory initiatives.

notizie.titolo: Appointments to BIS global payments standard-setting body and Consultative Council for the Americas
notizie.descrizione: Bank of Korea Governor Hyun Song Shin appointed Chair of the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures (CPMI) for a three-year term from 1 November. In addition, the Board of Directors has extended the term of Tiff Macklem, Governor of the Bank of Canada, as Chair of the Consultative Council for the Americas (CCA) until 31 March 2027.

notizie.titolo: Guidelines on counterparty credit risk management – Executive Summary
notizie.descrizione: Counterparty credit risk (CCR) is the risk that a counterparty defaults before final settlement of a transaction’s cash flows.

notizie.titolo: Inflation expectations in the context of climate change and the green transition
notizie.descrizione: This paper studies how views on climate change shape household inflation expectations. Using a new representative survey of Dutch households, we elicit perceptions of climate change, the green transition and climate policies, and their expected effects on long-run inflation.

notizie.titolo: The carrot, the stick and the yardstick: big techs’ implications for open finance
notizie.descrizione: Open finance can play a significant role in transforming financial services by promoting competition, innovation, efficiency and financial inclusion through customer-permissioned data sharing.

notizie.titolo: When the unthinkable happens: perceptions of monetary policy in tail events
notizie.descrizione: Focus Public perceptions of monetary policy play a central role in determining the effectiveness of policy actions. Despite central banks’ efforts to improve communication, the public has an incomplete understanding of how policymakers respond to economic shocks. This challenge becomes particularly acute during rare and severe shocks, or “tail events”, that fall outside past experience. In such circumstances, misperceptions about monetary policy can amplify economic fluctuations and undermine stabilisation efforts. In this paper we examine how public perceptions of monetary policy evolve following tail events and whether misperceptions can amplify and propagate their macroeconomic effects. C

notizie.titolo: Immigrants' skills and capital deepening: evidence from Chile
notizie.descrizione: We study the effect of migration on firms’ capital deepening, leveraging a massive influx of immigrant workers with varying skill sets from Venezuela and Haiti in Chile between 2015 and 2019.

notizie.titolo: "Eppur si muove": convergence within and between countries
notizie.descrizione: Kremer, Willis, and You (2022) report that over six decades richer countries lost their growth advantage. Acemoglu and Molina (2022) and Pesaran and Smith (2026) reply that such regressions cannot measure catch-up when countries head toward different moving destinations.

notizie.titolo: The gig economy and digital payments
notizie.descrizione: The growth of the “gig” economy could have far-reaching implications for payment systems. Gig work involves digital platforms that intermediate between workers and (retail or business) customers, in areas as diverse as ride-hailing and food delivery, freelance design and professional services, and customer service.

notizie.titolo: MaRCo@BIS: AI-agentic econometric analysis for central bankers
notizie.descrizione: This paper introduces MaRCo@BIS, the MAcroeconometric Research Companion: a framework of plain-text workflow files, a verified dictionary of canonical model specifications and a tested reference library, read by an off-the-shelf agentic coding environment.

notizie.titolo: Ready-to-run global liquidity stress tests for banks and banking systems
notizie.descrizione: Liquidity risk remains a persistent threat to financial stability, as starkly demonstrated by the 2023 banking turmoil in the United States and Europe. Hence, the ability to quickly gauge banks’ liquidity risks could prove useful especially during periods of market stress, but also to assess differences in liquidity buffers across peer economies and banks.

notizie.titolo: US monetary policy, macroeconomic news and the global secular decline of interest rates
notizie.descrizione: The global secular decline in long-term interest rates since the 1990s has been largely driven by cumulative yield changes during U.S. monetary policy announcement windows (FOMC windows).

notizie.titolo: Gaining (and losing) currency: a global database of currencies, 1850-2026
notizie.descrizione: Over the past two centuries, officially issued currencies have become firmly en trenched as a nearly universal institution in economies around the world. But the path to this arrangement has not been smooth: currencies have come and gone, in line with political changes, periods of hyperinflation or currency reforms and, in some cases, entry into currency unions.

notizie.titolo: Scenarios for future banking: implications for profitability, liquidity and solvency
notizie.descrizione: Who will perform banking’s core functions a decade from now, and how will risks and profitability evolve? Our framework structures expert judgement rather than forecasts.

notizie.titolo: Prewar US business cycles under uncertainty: reconstructing quarterly GDP before 1947
notizie.descrizione: Official quarterly US GDP estimates begin in 1947; earlier quarterly histories must be reconstructed using annual benchmarks and historical indicators. To investigate uncertainty in these reconstructions, this paper systematically compares specifications drawn from the literature for reconstructing quarterly GDP during 1919–1946. The comparison evaluates predictions on concealed postwar quarters and separates variation across specifications from coefficient uncertainty within a model.

notizie.titolo: Building AI on credit: structures and spillovers
notizie.descrizione: Capital expenditure to build artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure is growing fast, and a rising share is financed with long-term debt and through complex off-balance sheet arrangements.

notizie.titolo: Chokepoints in global supply chains: lessons from rare earths and hard disk drives
notizie.descrizione: Concentration and limited substitutability can turn the efficiency gains from global supply chains into vulnerabilities. However, the consequences of chokepoints depend on their underlying nature.

notizie.titolo: News shocks and inflation: theory and evidence from large oil discoveries
notizie.descrizione: We study how news shocks affect inflation in open economies, using large oil and gas discoveries with realized production lags of at least five years as observable news about future output. Panel local projections show that discoveries raise core consumer prices over the subsequent decade, with about half the increase occurring prior to extraction.

notizie.titolo: Bank liquidity regulation and the growth of private credit
notizie.descrizione: We study the role of bank liquidity regulation in the growth of private credit. Following the introduction of the liquidity coverage ratio (LCR), private credit increases significantly more in U.S. counties with a larger footprint of banks subject to the LCR or of LCR banks with greater initial liquidity shortfalls.

notizie.titolo: Inflation after the Iran war
notizie.descrizione: An unexpected increase in energy costs raises inflation directly through flexibly-set prices. Whether that shock amplifies to a larger and persistent rise in inflation depends on its transmission through the economy.

notizie.titolo: Competing rails for crossborder payments: banks, fintechs, and stablecoins
notizie.descrizione: Cross-border payments remain slow and expensive despite significant improvements in digital financial infrastructure over the past several decades.

notizie.titolo: Geoeconomic pressure
notizie.descrizione: The increasing use of geoeconomic pressure is reshaping the global economy.
